_milestone_note: FS 553.899 milestone inspection trigger. Uniform 30 years after the 2024 amendment (was 25 for buildings within 3 miles of the coast under SB-4D). verify against current statute text before relying on it in a deal.
_weights_note: concentration is weighted highest because a bulk owner above ~20% means someone is already assembling the building -- the strongest single signal in the screen. Tune here and re-run build_targets.py; nothing else needs to change.

shortlist._note: the stage-2 declaration pull is expensive, so it only runs on rows passing this gate plus a score cutoff

market._home_note: Miami-Fort Lauderdale-West Palm Beach. The default view, not a limit — all 469 scored markets are national and selectable.
market._weights_note: Driver weights. The overall score is 65% drivers + 35% headroom; headroom is what separates an EARLY market from a merely good one, since supply response and price run-up are what a developer arrives too late for.

memo.confidentiality: Confidential — for the recipient's evaluation only. Not an offer to sell securities.
memo._note: Offering memoranda are generated per condo target from data this app already holds: the scored target row, the unit-level tax roll and its recorded sales, the zoning envelope, and the metro screener. Set "firm" to put a name on the cover; leave it empty for an unbranded document.

comps._note: FDOR sale qualification codes treated as arm's-length. Applied ONLY where the roll carries QUAL_CD1 -- a NULL code means the roll had no such column and the sale is kept, because 'we cannot tell' is not 'disqualified'. Verify against the FDOR codebook for your roll year before relying on it; ingest_nal.py --show-header says whether the column is there at all.

pipeline._note: Deal state per building. `screened` is the implicit default for every row.

counties._note: Everything that was hardcoded to Miami-Dade. The FDOR NAL and the DBPR registry are STATEWIDE files with identical structure, so a new county is an entry here plus a zoning layer — not new code. state_plane is the EPSG the county publishes its X/Y in; bbox is a sanity gate that catches bad source coordinates landing in the sea.

BROWARD._note: nal_url is blank until the roll year is chosen; ingest_nal --county BROWARD says so.

PALM BEACH._note: No zoning layer wired yet, so capacity reports unresolved rather than guessing.
